newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco says premium not dependent on prices.
newsitem.headline: Codelco says premium not dependent on prices.

text.p: Chile's state copper company Codelco said it has decided to maintain its premium at $30/tonne for the second year running despite the recent slide in copper prices as the tariff is independent of market conditions.
"The premium does not depend on supply and demand," said Juan Eduardo Herrera, Codelco's vice president of sales.
"Market conditions are reflected in the level of prices."
Codelco announced this week it has fixed a premium of $30/tonne for cathode deliveries to six European ports next year, although the premium may vary to other destinations.
Herrera declined to comment on reports that Codelco has set a premium of $50 a tonne for deliveries to Japan and $40 for Taiwan, Korea and Hong Kong.
"I cannot comment. We will discuss this with individual customers," he said. --Margaret Orgill, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595x212
